## Rule

The four color-4 pixels mark the output crop rectangle. A separate small guide object outside that rectangle is scaled by a per-example block size and overlaid inside the crop; nonzero guide cells become scaled color blocks, zero guide cells remain background, and the four crop corners remain color 4.

## Cost analysis

Session-start LIVE (compress_v1) was 9,487 = mem 9,238 + 249p across 231 nodes — death by a thousand 20-300B intermediates. The 2026-06-07 byte-equal ladder (v3→v6) killed: the box-crop chain (−960), inbox/corner bool planes (−640), reduce-first yellow planes (→ einsum marginals), I64/F32 scalar slop (i32/i8/F16 discipline + ArgMax extents), [20,20]→[18,18] plane (generator-proven bounds), then **halved the plane itself by nibble-packing 2 cells/byte** (v6).

**v6 budget (mem 5,070):** packed plane 648+162 = 810 · output stage 1,652 (canvas16 320 + ScatterND 320 + sprw 112 + canvas30 Pad 900) · yellow einsums 240 · extents/guide/anchor/mag ≈ 700 (incl. unpack logic) · 3×6 moment window ≈ 450 · selection ≈ 230 · render index lanes ≈ 370 · scalars/glue ≈ 620.

**Formulation floor ≈ 4.6-4.8k** (revised after the nibble-pack broke the old 1,620-plane lemma — floors are formulation-relative, #68's own point):
- **Entry plane 810**: nibble-packed transport is the new local optimum (2 cells/byte is the u8 ceiling: 4 nibbles would need u16, no clean ORT path). Alternatives re-killed at the new price: per-row one-hot Gathers 1,200/row, einsum plane 3,600, QuantizeLinear 9,000.
- **Output stage ≈ 1,650 — FLOOR-FIXED per #81 (PAD-FLOOR CROSSOVER LAW, verdict applied 2026-06-07 final ping)**: v6 already ends `canvas → Pad → Equal == output` = AT the pattern floor; the law says do not re-convert. The one escape (#81 Where-as-output discriminator, 292-class) fails on THREE independent kills: (1) output is a TRANSLATED crop — untouched cells come from input at (brow+r, bcol+c), not (r,c), and a shifted passthrough costs a full-size one-hot gather ≥9,000B; (2) fill-ins are MULTI-COLOR (per-cell guide colors, not one broadcast e_k) so the value canvas survives anyway; (3) input content outside the output region (guide, bg beyond tall×wide) would leak — and §FREE-OUTPUT ACTIVE-MASK immunity rests on same-position passthrough, already falsified by (1). Earlier same-conclusion enumeration (independent): OneHot/BitwiseAnd tails (same 900), Conv-placer (F16 tax ≥2,560), QLC-placer (sq+concat ≥960), Gather-as-output (2,100), ScatterND-as-output (9,000p), direct-[30,30] render (+500); equality coupling barred from contraction finals by the #68 discriminator.
- **Matcher ≈ 680**: hypothesis lattice irreducible (topmost guide row unshown ~half the corpus); dual-moment is the cheapest exact certificate (single-conv fusion +90 after kernel assembly; packed-radix single-equality +216 on F32 width).

Remaining grindable slop ≈ 300-500 at <50B per edit. The <30% target (2,846) still needs ~1.8k more — not visible in this formulation class; next idea-classes would have to attack the 900B Equal-tail canvas (pinned by the equality coupling) or the 810B plane (pinned by u8 nibble ceiling).

## Don't-do log

- Raw 20x20 output shape fails `verify_against_live` because the official check compares the full one-hot tensor against live; compute compactly, then pad back to 30x30 instead.
- UINT16 index arithmetic is rejected by ORT for `Mul`; keep index math INT32.
- `GatherND` indices must be INT64 in this opset/runtime, but plain `Gather` accepts INT32 indices.
- Dynamic `Slice` can verify while scoring as `None` unless its output value_info is forced to static shape before saving.
- **(2026-05-29) Dynamic `Slice` (runtime starts/ends) → `score_network`/`calculate_memory` returns `None`** because strict shape-inference leaves the Slice output shape symbolic (unresolved intermediate). **Fix: crop at a dynamic offset with double-`Gather`** (`Gather(x, off+arange, axis=0)` then axis=1) — output shape = static index shape, so it scores. Used for the guide window + box crop.
- **(2026-05-29) Empty `roi` initializer for `Resize` (shape `[0]`) → `calculate_params` returns `None`** (its `any(d<=0 for d in dims)` guard fires). Pass `""` (optional input skip) for `roi`, never an empty tensor.
- **(2026-05-29) Do NOT use the generator's tight `irow ≤ tall-1-mag·t` bound as a structural constraint** — the 4 hand-authored ARC train/test pairs VIOLATE the random-path constraints (test pair: sprite reaches row `tall-1`; `irow=2 > tall-1-mag·t=1`). Using it drops visible to 263/266 (FAILS the 100% hard gate). The bundled `arc-gen` pairs DO follow generator constraints, but visible verify includes the hand-authored ones. Use only all-pairs-valid constraints: fit-to-box (`≤tall`/`≤wide`) + corner-guard + non-straddle.
- **(2026-05-29) `mag` ambiguity:** a few large blocks can be over-interpreted as fewer bigger blocks. Always pick the SMALLEST `mag` achieving full color-matched coverage (finest blocks = truth).
- **(2026-05-29) F16 is safe here** for the correlation (counts ≤~112) and color-index (0–9) — all exact in F16; halved correlation memory with zero divergence. This is the §14e-F16 exception (binary/small-int values, not lossy arithmetic).
- **(2026-06-07) CLIP-DUP PHANTOMS — shrinking the read plane changes Clip-overflow semantics.** On a [19,19] plane, `Clip(idx,0,18)` DUPLICATES the last real row/col where the [20,20] plane read an EMPTY row/col 19. Phantom guide rows/cols made wrong (gr,gc) hypotheses pass the moment test (4 visible fails: pairs 48/142/222/223 — e.g. srow=17 ⇒ GW rows [17,18,18dup]). Fix = exact empty-read emulation: (a) mask GW cells beyond the measured (gh,gw) extent, (b) bound mag-probe and window col validity by the plane edge (`≤ c17` alongside `≤ bright`). Any future plane shrink must re-prove every Clip's overflow target is empty OR masked.
- **(2026-06-07) `Where(bool,i8,i8)` has NO ORT CPU kernel** (NOT_IMPLEMENTED; probed v1.24.x, opset 14) — Sub/Div/Less/GreaterOrEqual/Cast i8 all work. Route i8 selects through u8: cast the i8 value to u8 BEFORE the Where (wrapped negatives land only in unselected lanes), keep selectors u8.
- **(2026-06-07) the scorer profiles on a DUMMY grid — data-dependent Gather/ScatterND indices MUST be crash-proof on garbage geometry** or `score_network_v2` returns None (ScatterND "invalid indice 29" from bbot=29 on an all-zero input). Clamp the render routing (`gh≤3`, `gw≤5` — identity on real inputs) and Clip scatter indices to data bounds; bounding the SEMANTIC scalars is cheaper than clipping every consumer vector.
- **(2026-06-07) Einsum can drop the batch axis in the output** (`'bchw,c->h'` → [30]) — scalars/vectors come out rank-clean, killing Reshape/keepdims plumbing; `'bchw,bchw->'` self-dot replaces Mul+ReduceSum for Σx² (F16 = cast-inserted F32, exact ≤2048).
- **(2026-06-07, v6) max of PACKED nibble-bytes is BOOLEAN-ONLY.** `ReduceMax` over packed `(lo + 16·hi)` values is valid for `>0` content tests, but the nibbles of a maxed byte are cross-row garbage (`max(8+16·1, 0+16·3) = 48` loses the lo=8). For nibble-level checks, gather the REAL pair column and reduce each nibble plane separately (4 visible fails before the fix).
- **(2026-06-07, v6) clip CELL coords BEFORE pair/parity decomposition.** For negative out-of-plane coords (box marker at grid col 0 ⇒ plane coord −1), `Div`-trunc + `Mod`(sign=divisor) route to a DIFFERENT phantom cell than a clipped-cell gather (pair 0 HI vs cell 0) — 1,072 corpus divergences vs the clipped-read baseline until cells were clipped first. Phantom reads can be VALID per box-geometry bounds when bcol_abs=0, so "excluded by validity" does NOT cover this.
